title: Project Scaffolding + PDF Rendering Engine
description: Create WPF application project with PDFium integration. Implement continuous vertical scroll PDF viewing with fit-to-width rendering. Include file open dialog and basic window chrome.
action: Create .NET 8 WPF project 'PdfTeachAnnotator'. Add NuGet packages: PdfiumViewer (or Docnet.Core for PDFium bindings). Implement MainWindow with ScrollViewer containing ItemsControl that renders PDF pages as Image elements. Each page rendered via PDFium at screen DPI, scaled to fit viewport width. Support opening PDF via File > Open dialog and drag-drop.

criteria: PdfTeachAnnotator.csproj contains PackageReference for PDF rendering library
PdfRenderService.cs contains 'RenderPage' method that returns BitmapSource
convergence.verification: dotnet build src/PdfTeachAnnotator && dotnet run --project src/PdfTeachAnnotator -- test.pdf
convergence.definition_of_done: Application opens, loads a PDF file, and displays all pages in continuous vertical scroll fitted to window width

files.change: Create .NET 8 WPF project with PDFium NuGet reference
ScrollViewer + ItemsControl for PDF pages, menu bar with File > Open
ObservableCollection<BitmapSource> Pages, OpenFileCommand, current PDF path tracking
PDFium wrapper: OpenDocument, GetPageCount, RenderPage(pageIndex, width) -> BitmapSource

implementation: Create solution file: dotnet new sln -n PdfTeachAnnotator -o src/
Create WPF project: dotnet new wpf -n PdfTeachAnnotator -o src/PdfTeachAnnotator --framework net8.0-windows
Add PDFium NuGet: dotnet add src/PdfTeachAnnotator package Docnet.Core (or PdfiumViewer if Docnet unavailable)
Implement PdfRenderService: wrap PDFium native calls, expose RenderPage(int pageIndex, int targetWidth) returning BitmapSource
Implement MainViewModel with INotifyPropertyChanged: Pages collection, OpenFileCommand (RelayCommand), LoadPdf(string path) that renders all pages at viewport width
Design MainWindow.xaml: DockPanel with Menu (File>Open, File>Exit) at top, ScrollViewer with VirtualizingStackPanel containing ItemsControl bound to Pages
Add drag-drop support on MainWindow for .pdf files
Wire up viewport SizeChanged to re-render pages at new width (fit-to-width)

integration: Manual: open app, load PDF, verify continuous scroll and fit-to-width

reference.pattern: Standard WPF MVVM with service layer

rationale.chosen_approach: PDFium renders pages to bitmaps displayed in virtualized ItemsControl. Simple, proven pattern for PDF viewing in WPF.
decision_factors: Bitmap rendering avoids complex PDF layout
ItemsControl with VirtualizingStackPanel handles large documents
rationale.tradeoffs: Bitmap approach uses more memory than vector rendering but is simpler and more reliable

risks: PDFium native DLL loading on different machines
Memory usage with large PDFs (mitigate with virtualization)
